boundaries: One fixed flat practice point. Ramps, rails, steps and obstacles are scenery, with no skate traversal, ramp dynamics, grind or obstacle collision implementation.
Net up-drag24–160px maps to0.3–1.1 display units; larger valid up-drags are capped. Recorded speed does not affect height. Reject short, downward and more than100px horizontal displacements.

Authored display trajectory:0.28s preparation,2sqrt(2h/9.8) air and0.30s landing. Original skate-stand/skate-air are mixed continuously; original air clip alone does not move the rider root upward. No full ollie, foot IK or athlete physics claim.

Only12/18 conservative original sole vertices and their two support points are evaluated. Real flat board deck is fitted and a common upward correction preserves that relation while preventing original board floor penetration. Entire foot, shoe contact patch, friction and biomechanical accuracy are unverified.

Only completed actual gestures create trials. Previews, seek, replay and cancellation do not. Stable JSON stores camera, preset/custom view, preview height and at most40 completed numeric trial records; transient animation is not persisted.

Local bundled assets and self-owned runtime code, with no runtime language model or external generation API. Header navigation is ordinary scene access and does not expand the six registered C35 return routes.
